info.title: OpenClinic — Electronic Health Record (EHR) & Governance API
info.description: Open, modular, and auditable Electronic Health Record (EHR) and Clinical Management API with hybrid access control (RBAC + ACL), multi-tenancy, dynamic capabilities resolution, and enterprise security (Argon2id + in-memory JWT).

get.description: Checks if the API process is alive
Checks if the API and database dependency are ready to accept traffic

post.description: Authenticates a user via username or email with Argon2id-protected password. Returns short-lived JWT access token and sets secure HttpOnly refresh token cookie.
Registers a new user into the system when self-registration is enabled.
Generates a new access token using the refresh token from HttpOnly cookie or request body.

refresh_token.description: Optional refresh token in body if not using cookie

get.description: Returns profile data, title, role, and groups of the authenticated user.
Returns profile data, title, role, and groups of the authenticated user.
Returns dynamic navigation menu structure based on active role and permissions.

200.description: Estrutura de menu com papel e lista de itens

schema.description: Estrutura de menu com papel e lista de itens

post.description: Allows the authenticated user to change their own password by providing their current password.
Triggers password recovery workflow and generates temporary reset token.
Resets user password using the recovery token.
Terminates active session and clears the HttpOnly refresh token cookie.

get.description: Returns list of registered users with roles, active status, and lockout state.

post.description: Creates a new user in the clinic with designated role and initial password.

put.description: Updates profile information and RBAC role of an existing user.

delete.description: Deletes a user from the system (with protections against self-deletion and owner deletion).

post.description: Allows Administrator/Owner to set a new password directly for another user.

patch.description: Activates or deactivates user system access.

post.description: Clears security lockout applied after repeated failed login attempts.

get.description: Returns list of registered groups with count of linked members.

post.description: Registers a new group for user aggregation and ACL permissions inheritance.

description.example: Specialist physicians with access to cardiology reports

put.description: Updates name, description, and active status of an existing group.

delete.description: Deletes a user group and unbinds its associated permissions.

get.description: Returns users belonging to the group and users available for association.

post.description: Associates an existing user with the group to grant inherited permissions.

delete.description: Disassociates a user from the group.

get.description: Returns list of groups the user belongs to and available groups.

post.description: Adds a group to the user groups list.

delete.description: Removes the binding between user and group.

get.description: Returns the active set of direct and group-inherited permission keys for the authenticated user.
Returns the consolidated matrix of authorized resources, routes, permitted actions, and UI metadata.

get.summary: Get Navigation Menu by Architecture Context
get.description: Returns authorized navigation items filtered by application context (ARCH or BUSINESS).
Returns the flat list of all manageable resources within the IAM subsystem.
Returns hierarchical resource tree structured with parents and children for permission management.
Returns permissions directly granted to a specific user.
Returns permissions inherited by a user through their group memberships.
Returns permissions configured for a specific group.

post.description: Saves the complete ACL permission matrix in batch for a user or group.

get.summary: Get Public Application Branding and Settings
get.description: Returns publicly accessible application branding (appSubtitle, appLogoUrl, appFaviconUrl, locales) from database for unauthenticated bootstrap.
Returns the primary application record with branding, platform security invariants, and audit policies (OWNER only).

put.description: Updates branding, platform security invariants, and audit policies for the base application (OWNER only).

get.description: Returns the application metadata combined with current tenant operational parameters (ADMIN or OWNER).

put.description: Updates local operational parameters and rules for the current tenant in sys_application_configs (ADMIN or OWNER).

get.description: Returns the list of all tenants registered in sys_tenants ordered by is_default DESC, name ASC.

post.description: Creates and registers a new organization tenant in the multi-tenant registry.

get.description: Returns the specified tenant record by its UUID identifier.

put.description: Updates configuration, fiscal data, and operational status of an existing tenant.

delete.description: Soft-deletes a tenant record. The primary default tenant cannot be deleted.

get.description: Lists non-deleted patients in the authenticated tenant. Requires op_patients READ permission.
